data.gender_notes: Aglat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘agl’, meaning ‘to exalt’ or ‘to be noble’. This name carries the spiritual essence of being highly esteemed and revered in Islam. The name Aglat carries the meaning “Exalted, Noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aglat usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of reverence and respect in the divine presence.
data.etymology: Aglat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted, Noble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aglat total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_urdu.name: اگلاٹ
in_urdu.meaning: غلط، معنی بالغلط، باطل، فاسد، خاطی
in_urdu.long_meaning: اگلاٹ: گَلَط کا نام ہے، اور اس کا معنی گَلَط کے ساتھ ہے، جو کہ باطل اور فاسد ہے۔ یہ نام گَلَط کے الفاظ سے بنا ہوا ہے، جس کا معنی باطل اور فاسد ہے۔ اگلاٹ نام کا استعمال اسلامی روایات میں کیا جاتا ہے، اور یہ نام گَلَط کو ظاہر کرنے کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ اگلاٹ نام کا مطلب ہے کہ اس شخص کو گَلَط کا علم ہے، اور وہ گَلَط کے خلاف ہے۔ یہ نام پاکستان، بنگلہ دیش، اور انڈیا کے مسلمانوں میں بہت مقبول ہے۔

in_english.long_meaning: Aglat is a name derived from the word glat, which means error, mistake, false, and corrupt. The name Aglat is used in Islamic tradition to refer to someone who is prone to error, mistake, or corruption. In Arabic, the name Aglat is written as أغلط (aglat) and is derived from the root word glat, which means to make a mistake or to err. The name Aglat is also used in Urdu and Hindi languages, where it is written as اگلاٹ (Aglat) and اगलत (Agalat) respectively. In Islamic tradition, the name Aglat is considered to be a name of good omen and is associated with qualities such as honesty, integrity, and righteousness.
